Against bifrost.localdev.com (HTTP used for the local self-signed ingress), the official OpenAI Python SDK Responses stream emitted image-generation events and completed with response.completed. The Images API n=2 request reached the fresh pod and returned the provider's explicit unsupported_operation error for Codex, not a Bifrost schema or transport failure.
pending.verification: The worktree runtime deployment is healthy and the Responses schema fix passes end-to-end. The multi-image request is correctly formed and routed, but the configured Codex provider does not implement image_generation on /v1/images/generations. To observe two returned images, the same deployed gateway must be configured with an image-capable OpenAI-compatible provider/model; changing the gateway code cannot add that upstream capability.
